# jenkins_folder (Data Source)

Gets information about an existing Jenkins Folder. Requires the cloudbees-folder plugin.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jenkins_folder" "services" {
  name   = "services"
  parent = "team-a"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Jenkins folder

### Optional

- `parent` (String) Path of the parent folder, for example `team-a/services`. Leave unset to look up a folder at the Jenkins root.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Folder description
- `id` (String) Full path of the folder, for example `team-a/services`.
